new_en:
W / A / S / D | Move | W moves forward, A moves left, S moves backward, and D moves right. | 
Left Shift | Walk | Walk silently | 
Left Ctrl | Duck | Crouch/down | 
Spacebar | Jump | Jump | 
E | Use | Interact, such as defuse or use objects | 
Left Mouse Button | Fire | Fire weapon | 
Right Mouse Button | Secondary Fire | Weapon secondary mode by weapon type | 
R | Reload | Reload | 
Q | Last Weapon Used | Return to previous weapon | 
G | Drop Weapon | Throw current weapon to the ground | 
B | Buy Menu | Open weapon/purchase menu | 
1 / 2 / 3 | Select weapons | 1 Primary weapon, 2 Secondary weapon, 3 Knife | 
4 | Cycle Grenades | Select grenade category | 
Tab | Scoreboard | Enable scoreboard | 
Y / U | Chat | Y opens global chat; U opens team chat. |
